contentList.content: Arms
You are a seasoned veteran, using your might and a variety of overpowering attacks to strike your opponents down.
Protection
You are an unyielding bulwark, holding the line against any foe so that your allies can fight on.
Shield Slam
Slam a creature with your shield, possibly knocking it <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>.
Armor Class
Shield Block

Raise your shield to deflect incoming blows, gaining +[1] <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> for [2] turns. For the duration, the damage of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShieldSlam_Protection">Shield Slam</LSTag> will be increased by the same amount.
<LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> and damage of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShieldSlam_Protection">Shield Slam</LSTag> increased by [1].
Ignore Pain

Steel yourself against harm, gaining <LSTag Tooltip="TemporaryHitPoints">temporary hit points</LSTag> equal to [1] times your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">Proficiency Bonus</LSTag> for [2] turns.
Ignoring pain, shrugging off incoming blows with <LSTag Tooltip="TemporaryHitPoints">temporary hit points</LSTag>.
You learn new Warrior Abilities to deal colossal blows to your enemies. Most can be used once per <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>.
Cooldown: Once per <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>.
Cooldown: Once per <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>.
Cooldown: Once per combat.
Overpower
Turn a miss on a melee weapon <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> into a hit.
Colossus Smash

Smash through a creature's defences, reducing its <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> by 5 until the end of your turn. If it fails a <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>, the reduction lasts until the end of your next turn instead.
Armour Class reduced by 5.
Sweeping Strikes
Prepare to sweep through your foes. Your next 2 melee Warrior Abilities can target 1 additional creature within range.
Your melee Warrior Abilities can target 1 additional creature within range.
Cleave
Swing your weapon in a wide arc, striking up to [1] creatures in front of you.
Mortal Strike
Strike a creature and inflict <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MORTAL_WOUNDS">Mortal Wounds</LSTag>, preventing it from regaining <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag>.
Mortal Wounds
Cannot regain <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag>.
Slam
Deal a mighty blow that consumes all your available attacks for this action.

Deals weapon damage once, or twice if you have <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="ExtraAttack">Extra Attack</LSTag> or thrice if you have <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="ExtraAttack_2">Improved Extra Attack</LSTag>.
Fervor of Battle

When you attack at least [1] enemies with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Whirlwind_Warrior">Whirlwind</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_Cleave_Arms">Cleave</LSTag>, your next <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Slam_Arms">Slam</LSTag> has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> and ignores its cooldown.

Your next <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Slam_Arms">Slam</LSTag> has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> and ignores its cooldown. Expires on <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>.
Dreadnaught
Cause a seismic wave and strike all creatures in a line.
Revenge
When an enemy misses an attack against you, your next <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_Cleave_Arms">Cleave</LSTag> ignores its cooldown.
Your next <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_Cleave_Arms">Cleave</LSTag> ignores its cooldown.
Strategist
Dealing damage with a Warrior Ability resets the cooldown of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShieldSlam_Protection">Shield Slam</LSTag>.
